verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Computer can search and browse the web in real time, including login-gated pages, and can run browser tasks across dozens of URLs in parallel with structured output. They also cover webpage screenshots and approval prompts for sensitive actions. Together these clearly deliver the core of an assistant operating a browser to research and act on websites. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of interactive site actions (clicking, form-filling, completing transactions), and independent or hands-on corroboration that browser tasks work as claimed.
